review.notes: All 12 physical pages' extracted text was diffed line-wise against the OCR Markdown (case/punctuation normalized) plus a fence/heading structure scan (no code fences). Rendered verification at 110-300 dpi on physical pages 1, 2, 5 and 10. Physical page 1 is a designed poster cover whose panel labels (brand wordmark, robot names, INSTRUCTION, First-person (PoV)) are printed as small graphic labels inside the cover composition; the OCR promoted them to level-2 document headings, so they are demoted to plain text while the text itself is preserved. The 'MistralAI' logo wordmark and the '77.4% SUCCESS RATE' badge exist only inside the poster graphics (absent from the PDF text layer), so their absence from OCR text is correct. Body math (O(T^2), 22x, -max(2, dist_to_goal), waypoint delta notation), Table 1 values and the contributor/reference lists match the print. The PDF's own spelling 'embodiement-specific' (physical p.4, printed typo) was left as OCR-normalized 'embodiment-specific' and kept out of patches per source-faithful review rules.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.1 poster cover shows the orange infographic wordmark 'Robostral Navigate' as a graphic element inside the cover composition, below the document's serif title 'Robostral Navigate' (which is the OCR's # title). The duplicate heading promotion is removed; the printed label text is kept as plain text.
Rendered physical p.1 shows 'Galaxea-R1' as a small robot-badge label above the first demo panel of the poster graphic, not a document section heading; demoted to plain text.

Rendered physical p.1 shows 'INSTRUCTION' as a small caption label directly above the Hiwonder JetAuto instruction box inside the poster graphic (the Galaxea-R1 panel uses the same label style); a spurious heading promoted from a prompt-box label, demoted to plain text.

Rendered physical p.1 shows 'First-person (PoV)' as a small orange video-row label inside the poster graphic; the second panel's identical label is already plain text in the OCR, so the heading promotion is removed for consistency with the printed layout.
Rendered physical p.1 shows 'Hiwonder JetAuto' as a small robot-badge label above the second demo panel of the poster graphic, not a document section heading; demoted to plain text.

Rendered physical p.2 prints 'Webpage: https://mistral.ai/news/robostral-navigate' as a small bold-label plus monospace link line between the Abstract paragraph and the heading '1 Introduction', at body level; the OCR's level-2 heading promotion is removed. Verified at 200 dpi.

Rendered physical p.5 shows '3D View of Trajectories' as the bold panel title inside Figure 3 (left panel, above the 3D trajectory plot); the string does not exist in the PDF page text layer outside the figure. Per review rules a heading whose text exists only inside a figure is demoted to plain text.
Rendered physical p.10 contributor list prints 'Marcin Możejko' with a dot-above z (ż, confirmed at 300 dpi); the OCR substituted a caron (ž), reading 'Možejko'.
